title: 第25章 魏族远古和上古老祖多半还活着第26章 死亡深渊死亡骨殿阴灵王
slug: 沉睡万年醒来一掌拍碎禁地
content_zh:
这到底是什么力量？！
太诡异，太可怕了！
隔空超远距离观望都不行，各大超古道统强者头皮剧烈发麻，内心全被恐惧占满！
甚至还有更加可怕的事情发生！
他们发现，他们心中的负面情绪，竟不受控制的疯狂冒了出来！
他们逐渐变得疯癫，理智在一点点消散！
这种诡异的力量，隔空也将他们心中的负面情绪给全面点燃了！
……
道一圣地那边，情况更为严重。
红毛魏族族长持红发长枪杀向陈长生身影。
诡异力量席卷整片天地。
道一圣地内的弟子成员，受到的影响最大！
他们全都疯了！
所有理智都在顷刻间消失！
心中负面情绪全面爆发！
圣地老祖们也不例外。
帝尊同挡不住这样的诡异力量。
他们疯癫，负面情绪吞噬掉所有理智。
全场唯独李若雪不受影响。
她的眼神依旧清澈。

诡异力量完全对她不起作用。
唰——
陈长生身影挥手。
所有诡异力量全消。
疯癫，失去理智的众人，也全面恢复。
红毛魏族族长拎着红毛长枪杀来。
其之一枪无比恐怖骇然。
似可贯穿万古岁月。
一枪向陈长生身影刺去。
诡异道则伴随红毛长枪交织。
不夸张的说。
这一枪绝对可以刺杀掉大部分超天帝生灵。
就在这一枪即将刺中陈长生身影时。
陈长生身影动了。
他一巴掌抽了过去。
轰——
不可想象的至高力量爆发。
content_en:
What kind of power is this? !
So weird, so scary!
Even watching from a very long distance was no longer possible. The scalps of all the powerful super-ancient cultivators were numbing violently, and their hearts were filled with fear!
There are even scarier things happening!
They discovered that the negative emotions in their hearts emerged uncontrollably and crazily!
They are gradually becoming crazy, and their sanity is disappearing little by little!
This strange power ignited all the negative emotions in their hearts from afar!
…
Over at Daoyi Holy Land, the situation is even more serious.
The red-haired Wei clan leader pointed at Chen Changsheng's figure with a red-haired spear.
Strange power swept the entire world.
The disciple members in Daoyi Holy Land were the most affected!
They are all crazy!
All sanity disappears in an instant!
The negative emotions in my heart burst out in full force!
The ancestors of the Holy Land are no exception.
Emperor Zun can't stop such strange power.
They are crazy, and their negative emotions swallow up all reason.
Li Ruoxue was the only one in the audience who was not affected.
Her eyes were still clear.
Strange powers have no effect on her at all.
Swish——
Chen Changsheng's figure waved.
All strange powers are gone.
Everyone who went crazy and lost their minds also fully recovered.
The red-haired Wei clan leader came carrying a red-haired spear.
One of the shots was extremely terrifying.
It seems to last through eternity.
A gun shot towards Chen Changsheng's figure.
The strange path is accompanied by red-haired spears.
Not an exaggeration.
This shot can definitely kill most of the Super Heavenly Emperor creatures.
Just when the shot was about to hit Chen Changsheng's figure.
Chen Changsheng's figure moved.
He slapped it.
Boom——
An unimaginable burst of supreme power.
